acquisition_method.evidence: The peptides were analyzed on an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) in data-dependent mode, with the full scans performed at a resolving power of 120.000 FWHM (2100 V, mass range: 350–1200 m/z, AGC target value: 1 × 10e6 ions, maximum injection time: 50 ms).
